lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Qatar through the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API. The dataset represents approximately 32% of estimated total buildings based on AI-mapped estimates, with an average data age of 2 years and continuous updates from the OSM community.
